text:
zara: quick bring-up for Aurora-embed candidate + compact strategies. float32 recall@10=0.872 on holdout-30k. naive int6-pq -> 0.778, int8 -> 0.859. posted plot: https://internal.s3/aurora/4287650000/summary.png :mag:
dan: which pooling + normalize? pq config?
zara: pooled mean -> l2 normalize. initial run used PQ m=16, no OPQ. eval command below:

```
./embed_eval --model aurora-v1 \
  --pooling mean --normalize true \
  --quant int6 --pq-m 16 --opq 0 \
  --index hnsw --M 32 --ef_construction 200 \
  --holdout holdout-30k.jsonl \
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette,neighbor_swap_rate
```

zara: OPQ(32) before PQ brings recall@10 to 0.829 and silhouette 0.35. short queries still the worst: float32 short<=6 tokens 0.798 -> int6+opq 0.745. uploaded cohort CSV: https://internal.s3/aurora/4287650000/cohorts.csv
mike: try normalize->opq->pq and also OPQ retrain seeded w/ short-query shard. did that?
zara: yes retrained OPQ on short shard; recall@10 improved short->0.768, overall 0.835. neighbor_swap_rate dropped from 0.038 -> 0.017.
dan: what about concat-last2 + pca reduce then pq? sometimes stabilizes short anchors.
zara: concat-last2+pca(768)+opq+pq gave recall@10 0.847 and short 0.786 but index +20%. latency for concat precompute negligible for stored vectors but increases memory footprint.
mike: ef_search sweep? can ef help without changing index size?
zara: ef_search: 128->0.789, 256->0.815, 512->0.838 for int6+opq; latency ~2.1x at 512. so helps but not enough for shortest cohort.
eval-bot: auto-regression scan: flagged short_queries recall@10 delta -0.03 and faq-anchor delta -0.025. status: needs-triage.
dan: rollout suggestion: default = int8+opq; compact int6 allowed only if one of: (a) concat-last2 precompute, (b) OPQ retrain on short shard, or (c) async rerank for short queries. require silhouette>=0.34 and neighbor_swap_rate<=0.02 for int6.
\zm: (typo) mike: agreed. add canary: 1% traffic, route short queries to larger-index replica if enabled. monitor live recall on sampled pairs.
zara: i'll push PR with recommended index params, cohort csv, and canary plan in ~30m. queue overnight fuzzcheck of paraphrases. job id fj-4287650000. ETA ~10h. thanks :thumbsup:
